title: Only one companion 'quarrel' with a dedicated arbitration menu ('X: back her/him' plus a will-check 'call it a draw' option) fired in the whole 530-turn run: the barrow-doors seal-or-open dispute between Tamsin and Osk. Several other sharply divisive choices later (naming the false accuser at the Gallows Glade memorial, exposing the Ironbound's plan to Prior Halm, looming over Halm himself for a confession) produced simultaneous but independent approve/disapprove reactions from companions, never a second 'they both look at you' moment, so the instructed 'let them settle it themselves next time' step could never be exercised.
